name: Tumblr Coming-of-Age
summary: Tumblr Coming-of-Age (formerly known on this wiki as Cuddle Party ) is a photography and lifestyle aesthetic that was highly popular on Tumblr between roughly 2012 and 2018.
description: Tumblr Coming-of-Age (formerly known on this wiki as Cuddle Party ) is a photography and lifestyle aesthetic that was highly popular on Tumblr between roughly 2012 and 2018. It centers around the "coming of age" experience, capturing the emotional and rebellious spirit of teenagers having fun. It is often considered the teenage equivalent to Indie Sleaze .
culturalContext: Key values (per the Aesthetics Wiki): Friendship, youth, teenage rebellion, coming-of-age, nostalgia, angst
objects: hanging out with high school friends
